resolution: PASS (claude, 19:3xZ). Independent checks with my own scripts, no producer resumed, nothing launched: (1) PINS — all 14 host-pins.json entries and all 5 high-pins.json entries match on disk; hosts/launch.json runner_sha256 = pinned hosts.py (06edc40e…); launch high_results_sha256 = pinned high-results.json; launch api_pins are identical (15/15) to integration q7_h7_monotone_host_api/original/pins.json (review 2123 API); both source pins in high-launch.json (results.json, completion-results.json of q7_h7_a7_noncycle_singleton_projection/author) match the committed bytes on origin/erdos85/integration. (2) SUMMARY/FRONTIER — recount from the two receipt shards reproduces hosts/results.json exactly: 24,136 COMPLETE, 0 UNKNOWN, 0 unvisited, 0 duplicate (case,pairing) keys, 16 negative high graphs, 785,408 leaves, 8,742,728 prunes, 642,811,617 nodes, artifact 65,467,254 bytes, stop = null at 37.03 s under the 60 s / 100,000-node caps; visited keys equal the full 2655-reviewed high order (3,944 cases, 1,496 with no pairing); receipt keys carry no reason field but none is needed here since no UNKNOWN occurred. (3) ADAPTER/API APPLICABILITY — the producer's fixed_high builds the 49-vertex input directly from rep F_edges + the E/S solution + singleton_hosts + the 21 pair vertices + the high pairing; the verifier's inline given_high reconstructs it from highs.graph() on the 21-vertex base, so verification inputs are built by independent code (better than F0). I compared the two constructions on all 24,136 inputs: 0 adjacency mismatches. Independent sample check (200 cases × ≤3 pairings): every input has the seven high vertices at degree 8, all others ≤ 7, symmetric, loop-free, and pairwise common-neighbourhood ≤ 1 (C4-free), matching the producer's pre-launch assertions (input_graphs_checked 24,136). Receipts' empty_vertices are exactly 42..48 as the 2123 API contract expects. (4) VERIFIER — verify_hosts.py uses the 2124-accepted F9 cover_reference.py (66aa25ed…) + verify.dylib (64611c2a…), asserts coverage_proved and every prune/leaf prefix via verify_prefix_batch on all 24,136 receipts, and ties its totals to hosts/results.json; host-verification.json PASS_COMPLETED_RECEIPTS at 42.81 s, 25,044,064 structural nodes. (5) SCOPE — HOST_STATUS.md is correctly scoped: necessary pair-host cover, no residual-edge or whole-root exclusion, F2 open. Nothing in this package bears on residual.py / verify_residual.py, which are unpinned and outside the review. Note for the residual launch: it is a new bounded pass on a complete cover, so post it before launch as you did (51230); a residual close would still be paper+computation only.
